comments: cb555372: This program is used for deleting patient incomplete records.
819d8363: Entry point for the program.
53d4647a: Check if division selection is required and prompt the user to select one if necessary.
feaf2e0e: If a division has not been selected, automatically select the first one.
6efbb0b5: Warn the user if the medical center division file has not been set up for delinquency tracking.
b67bf5f2: Screen for incomplete records belonging to the selected division.
c6eb13dd: Prompt the user to select a patient's incomplete record to delete.
0225caea: Prepare for displaying the incomplete record details.
2901b93c: Initialization for the OK to Delete process.
d6e048bd: Reset the return screen control variable.
1476a057: Select the record to be deleted.
db654961: Prepare the screen for a full view before proceeding.
5191592e: Process the selected record for deletion.
8f2d8633: Return to the report after completing the delete operation.
5fd4514d: Prompt the user for confirmation before deletion.
5cf47e51: If confirmed, delete the record and display a deletion message.
fe861dac: Exit the deletion confirmation dialog if the user selects 'No'.
1aca1fcc: Set a flag to indicate the user has exited the operation.
2fd1b1c9: Cleanup and exit routine.
6f4260ce: Provide instructions for the Yes/No confirmation prompt.
